baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated negation in la yadhūqūna fīhā bardan wa-lā sharāban joins the verb ذ و ق to ب ر د and ش ر ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: Tasting is an embodied access channel, while cooling and liquid intake are the two complementary routes by which heat and thirst would normally be relieved; the construction closes both routes.

activation_trace.role: Mouth-tasting supplies the bodily access channel through which the denied objects would be encountered.
Coldness and what cools supply thermal relief as the first excluded object.
Imbibing liquid supplies hydric relief as the second excluded object.

changed_reading.before: The ayah merely lists coolness and a beverage as two absent items.
changed_reading.after: The ayah closes a paired bodily relief system: neither thermal easing nor liquid intake can reach them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same three focus roots permit yadhūqūna as undergoing, bardan as settled repose after heat or motion, and sharāban as an allotted water-share.
baseline_models.mechanism: The deprivation can operate temporally and distributively: no experienced state settles into respite, and no recognized portion of water arrives to interrupt it.

activation_trace.role: Undergoing an ordeal expands tasting from a mouth event into lived exposure.
Still settlement after heat or motion supplies respite and cessation as the first denied state.
An allotted turn of water supplies a due portion as the second denied relief.

changed_reading.before: The negation concerns only immediate temperature and thirst.
changed_reading.after: It also withholds durable repose and any assigned interval or share of relief.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventory links ذ و ق with experiential testing, ب ر د with settled stillness, and ش ر ب with understanding or absorption.
baseline_models.mechanism: A branch-level cognitive reading distinguishes raw exposure from assimilated knowledge: an ordeal may be undergone without becoming a calm, digestible understanding.

activation_trace.role: Experiential testing supplies unmediated knowing through what befalls a person.
Settled stillness supplies the calm in which an experience could resolve.
Drinking as understanding supplies inward cognitive assimilation, here negated.

changed_reading.before: Tasting and drinking are near-synonymous physical acts.
changed_reading.after: Tasting can be forced exposure while drinking marks the settled assimilation that never follows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following exception admits hot and outpouring fluids, while the later imperative repeats tasting as an ever-increasing punishment. Their sensory channel is therefore not disabled; it is selectively gated so that relief is excluded and harmful experience is admitted and amplified.

activation_trace.role: Experiential tasting makes the focus verb a channel for undergoing what is imposed.
Cooling is the beneficial thermal input blocked by the focus negation.
Ordinary liquid intake is the beneficial hydric input blocked alongside cooling.
Hot water supplies the non-cooling liquid admitted by the immediate exception.
Flowing or outpouring matter supplies a second harmful substitute for ordinary drink.
The imperative repetition turns tasting into compulsory exposure rather than absent sensation.
Increase makes the admitted punitive input cumulative rather than satiating.
Painful punishment names the product delivered through the repeated tasting channel.

structural_cues: 78:25 immediately follows the double negation with an exception.
78:30 repeats the focus verb as an imperative and restricts the increase to punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies excluded cooling and drink, admitted hot outflow, and a repeated imperative of increasing punishment; I infer a selective sensory gate from that sequence. A live alternative is that the exception merely inventories infernal liquids without modeling access as a gate.

changed_reading.before: They are simply unable to taste anything cooling or drinkable.
changed_reading.after: They remain fully exposed to tasting, but its input is engineered to admit only escalating anti-relief.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier heat is answered by delivered, pouring water that produces vegetation and gardens. At the focus, cooling and drink are absent, and the only following fluids are hot or noxiously outpouring. The ayah thus occupies a reversal of the surah's life-support cycle: fluid remains, but its cooling, hydrating, and generative functions have been inverted.

activation_trace.role: Cooling supplies the thermal regulation missing from the reversed system.
Liquid intake supplies the hydrating function missing from the reversed system.
Radiant heat supplies the ordinary thermal load that the provisioning sequence answers.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the life-supporting fluid input.
Abundant outpouring supplies the transfer mechanism by which water reaches the system.
Growth emerging from earth supplies the productive result of delivered water.
A tree-covered garden supplies the mature habitat generated by that water.
Hot water reverses the cooling function while preserving fluid form.
A harmful outflow reverses the earlier beneficial pouring.

structural_cues: 78:24-25 preserves heat and fluid while removing cooling, drinking, and growth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a productive water sequence and then an anti-cooling fluid sequence; I infer that the latter functionally reverses the former. A live alternative is that the creation signs and punishment items are adjacent catalogues rather than one inverted hydraulic mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes isolated thirst under heat.
changed_reading.after: It describes expulsion from the entire water cycle: fluid no longer cools, hydrates, or generates life.

context_deltas.mechanism: A water-like shimmer appears at the collapse of the mountains just before the infernal scene, but the focus denies drink. Appearance and consumable substance are split: the environment can present the sign of water while withholding any fluid that relieves.

activation_trace.role: Literal liquid intake supplies the bodily realization that the preceding appearance cannot provide.
A mirage shimmering like water supplies visible availability without drinkable substance.

structural_cues: The mirage closes the cosmic-disruption scene immediately before 78:21-24 localizes the inhabitants in Hell.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a water-like mirage followed by denied drink; I infer a frustrated transition from visible sign to bodily intake. A live alternative is that the mirage marks only the mountains' unreality and carries no hydric baiting function.

changed_reading.before: No drink means simple material absence.
changed_reading.after: The deprivation may be sharpened by deceptive availability: water can appear, but it can never become intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water-share branch of sharāb is activated by matched recompense, counting, exhaustive enumeration, binding record, and what hands earned. The missing share is not random scarcity; it functions as a precisely assessed anti-allotment within a juridical distribution.

activation_trace.role: An allotted turn of water supplies the distributive object whose absence is being assessed.
Recompense answering an act supplies the juridical frame for the deprivation.
A measure equal to its need or counterpart supplies proportional matching.
Counting and reckoning supply the assessment they had not expected.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies completeness to the assessment.
A written fixing that entails judgment supplies enforceability to the count.
What the hands earned supplies the assessed acts to which the anti-share corresponds.

structural_cues: 78:26 labels the immediately preceding deprivation and substitutes as matching recompense.
78:27-29 moves from rejected reckoning to exhaustive written enumeration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an allotted-water branch and a sequence of matching, counting, recording, and earned acts; I infer that withheld drink is a measured anti-share. A live alternative is that sharāb remains only a concrete beverage and the accounting sequence qualifies punishment generally.

changed_reading.before: The lack of drink is undifferentiated scarcity.
changed_reading.after: The withheld water-share is a calibrated juridical outcome, distributed in exact correspondence to recorded acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: Created sleep normally supplies rest and a cut in activity, but the inhabitants remain through extended periods while punishment increases, ending with a wish for dust. The settled-stillness branch of bard therefore becomes more than cooling: no reset, terminal quiet, or cessation interrupts the ordeal.

activation_trace.role: Undergoing an ordeal supplies the continuing exposure that would require interruption.
Settled stillness after heat or motion supplies the denied reset or cessation.
Sleep supplies the ordinary recurring interruption of conscious exertion.
Rest and stillness state the restorative function assigned to sleep.
Remaining in a place supplies uninterrupted confinement.
Extended periods supply the temporal scale across which relief fails to arrive.
Increase replaces cyclical reset with accumulation.
Dust supplies the wished-for terminal material state that the focus deprivation withholds.

structural_cues: The surah first assigns rest to sleep, then describes extended residence without a relieving interval.
The final wish to be dust places imagined cessation beyond the accumulating punishment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restorative sleep, prolonged residence, increase, and a dust-wish; I infer that denied bard blocks temporal reset and terminal quiet as well as cooling. A live alternative is that bard is wholly thermal and duration merely intensifies that literal deprivation.

changed_reading.before: They receive no cooling during a long punishment.
changed_reading.after: They receive no interruption at all: no restorative pause, settled end, or terminal cooling breaks the accumulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus and 78:35 share a negated sensory verb, fīhā, an object, and wa-lā plus a second object. Yet the focus excludes beneficial cooling and drink, while the garden supplies a full cup and excludes harmful speech. The parallel makes absence itself neutral: punishment and protection differ by which inputs the environment filters out.

activation_trace.role: Mouth-tasting supplies the infernal sensory channel governed by the first exclusion.
Cooling supplies a beneficial input excluded from the infernal environment.
Drink supplies the second beneficial input excluded from the infernal environment.
A cup defined with its contents supplies the positive drink omitted in the focus.
Fullness to the brim reverses deprivation with abundant admitted intake.
Hearing supplies the garden's parallel sensory channel.
False or ugly speech supplies a harmful input excluded protectively.
Untruth supplies the second harmful input excluded from the garden.

structural_cues: 78:24 and 78:35 repeat the frame la + sensory imperfect + fīhā + object + wa-lā + object.
78:34 places a brim-full cup immediately before the protective auditory negation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a close syntactic parallel and opposite-valued objects; I infer two environments that filter sensory inputs in inverse directions. A live alternative is that the shared syntax is rhetorical balance without a general sensory-gating mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a standalone list of missing comforts.
changed_reading.after: It defines an inverse sensory ecology: Hell excludes relief, while the garden admits fullness and excludes corruption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah moves from mutual questioning about arriving news to promised disclosure, then from the focus's denied cognitive drinking to an imperative of experiential tasting, and finally to tightly bounded intelligible speech and correctness. On this branch, truth is no longer calmly absorbed as discourse; it is learned bodily as ordeal.

activation_trace.role: Experience and testing supply compulsory knowledge through what befalls the subject.
Settled stillness supplies the calm resolution denied to that experience.
Drinking as understanding supplies discursive or inward assimilation, here negated.
Mutual questioning supplies the initial social mode of seeking knowledge.
A report that arrives and is conveyed supplies the disputed content offered to understanding.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the promised epistemic outcome.
The tasting imperative converts promised knowing into imposed experience.
Intelligible speech supplies a discursive channel that is later tightly restricted.
Correctness settled against error supplies the only qualified speech admitted at the endpoint.

structural_cues: The opening question-news-knowing progression returns as a command to taste in 78:30.
The closing scene restricts speech to an authorized and correct utterance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies questioning, arriving news, promised knowledge, repeated experiential tasting, and bounded correct speech; I infer a shift from assimilable report to coerced bodily knowing. A live alternative is that the epistemic arc and the physical drink in 78:24 remain separate domains.

changed_reading.before: The verse denies only a beverage during punishment.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory cognitive layer, it denies calm assimilation: disputed truth is no longer taken in as understanding but forced upon them as ordeal.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the garment branch of ب ر د, which is vocalically and semantically distant from the immediate coldness reading. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the surah's explicit clothing, shielding, and protection images; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary material echo, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus noun bardan can be tested against the ب ر د branch of a patterned garment or covering.

activation_trace.role: A garment or patterned covering supplies an exploratory protective layer withheld in the focus.
Covering by clothing supplies the surah's explicit environmental garment image.
A protective shield supplies the defensive function that a covering can perform.
Ward against harm supplies the protected condition contrasted with the focus.

changed_reading.after: As a contained branch echo, the focus also withholds insulation or protective covering inside an exposed environment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the false-charge branch of ش ر ب belongs to an idiom about making someone 'drink' what he did not do, whereas the focus has the simple noun sharāban. It remains worth carrying because exact recompense, enumeration, written fixation, and hand-earned acts surround the focus; downstream prose should mark it as a juridical undertone rather than a lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated sharāban is anchored to the ش ر ب branch for charging a person with what he did not drink or do.

activation_trace.role: The idiom of imputing an undrunk or undone act supplies the possibility of a false punitive charge.
Recompense answering an act supplies the requirement that punishment correspond to conduct.
Fit and agreement between two things supplies the absence of mismatch.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies evidentiary completeness against fabrication.
Written fixation that entails judgment supplies a binding record.
What the hands earned supplies personal provenance for the adjudicated acts.

changed_reading.before: The punishment scene is compatible with arbitrary imposition.
changed_reading.after: At a remote idiomatic edge, nothing they are made to bear is a fabricated charge; the imposed experience matches recorded acts.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers ش ر ب branches for permeation and watered growth from dye, plants, and land to punished bodies. It remains anchored in sharāban and is activated by the packet's water-to-plant-to-garden sequence; downstream prose should qualify it as a cross-domain material analogy, not an independent botanical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated sharāban is read through ش ر ب branches for inward permeation and watered green land.

activation_trace.role: Permeation into material or heart supplies inward hydration as a process rather than a beverage object.
Watered land and green growth supply the productive state that permeation would enable.
Delivered water supplies the external input available for absorption.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the visible result of successful inward watering.
The tree-covered garden supplies the mature ecological outcome denied by failed permeation.

changed_reading.before: No drink means that no cup reaches the mouth.
changed_reading.after: As a material analogy, no beneficial moisture can enter and transform them; they remain anti-soil that cannot cool or grow.

strongest_changes: The repeated ذ و ق at 78:30 changes absent sensation into selective compulsory tasting: relief is blocked while punishment enters and increases.
The productive heat-water-growth sequence of 78:13-16 is reversed in 78:24-25, where fluid loses its cooling, hydrating, and generative functions.
The allotted-water branch of ش ر ب becomes a measured anti-share under the matching, counting, recording, and earned-act sequence of 78:26-29 and 78:40.
The syntactic mirror at 78:35 shows inverse sensory filtering: Hell excludes benefits, while the garden supplies a full cup and excludes corrupt speech.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made the focus operate simultaneously as a bodily gate, a reversed water system, a timed denial of reset, a measured distribution, and an exploratory shift from assimilable report to forced experiential knowing.
remaining_uncertainties: The garment activation for ب ر د depends on a form-distant branch and should remain secondary.
The cognitive use of ش ر ب as understanding is structurally activated but may remain only analogical beside the concrete beverage.
The mirage may intentionally stage water-like nonavailability, or it may serve only the broader collapse of stable landscape.
